title: Scyotid
extract:
Scyotid is  Oraxia's signature throwing knives. Dealing  Toxin damage, its Alternate Fire throws a snare that binds and pulls in enemies.

Characteristics
This weapon deals primarily  Toxin damage.
Primary fire has innate 1.6 meter Punch Through.
Alternate Fire throws a webbed snare that damages, paralyzes for ~6 seconds, and groups up to 8 enemies within 15 meters.
Number of pulled enemies is multiplied by Multishot.
Radius is not affected by  Fulmination ( Primed).
Damage is not affected by mods, nor does it combine with or inflict modded elements.
Consumes 4 ammo per shot.
Innate  polarity.

Acquisition
Scyotid's main and component blueprints can be obtained from Isleweaver in Duviri. Access requires completion of The Hex Quest.
Alternatively, Scyotid's blueprints can be purchased from Acrithis or Dominus Thrax in the Dormizone, using  Scuttler Husk awarded from Isleweaver. Each component blueprint requires 12  and the main blueprint requires 48 , totaling 96  Scuttler Husks for the complete set.

All drop rates data is obtained from DE's official drop tables stored on Module:DropTables/data.
See Mission Rewards#Standard Missions for definitions on reward table rotations.
For more detailed definitions and information,
visit here.

Notes
As the alternate fire is unable to crit, repeated uses will build stacks of  Secondary Enervate without consuming them.

Trivia
The Scyotid name is based on the Scytodidae which a family of spiders known for lobbing venom coated silk onto their prey which fits in with the weapon innate toxin damages and being a throwable weapon.
The "barbs" projectiles might be a nod to how some Tarantulas defend themselves by sending harpoon shaped barbs in the air to blind any threats that might want to eat them.
